newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 30.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 30.

text.p: All major Mexican ports were open as of 1000 local/1600 GMT Monday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in a daily update.
The ministry updated port and shipping conditions for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.
Cloudy skies along the coasts of Guerrero, Oaxaca and Chiapas states, with north and northeast winds at up to 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 kilometers/11 to 17 miles per hour).

Light rain possible along the coast of Tamaulipas state and disperse clouds over the states of Veracruz, Tabasco and the Yucatan peninsula. Predominant winds at 10 to 15 knots from the east and southeast causing waves of up to three to five feet.

Tropical air carrying clouds over the coasts of Honduras and Belize and the state of Quintana Roo. Winds from the east at 10 to 20 knots (19 to 38 kilometers/11 to 22 miles) with waves four to six feet high.
